verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework. A runtime probe confirmed it pip-installs and imports keylessly. The docs describe a local development runner, and state that the same bot file is portable to most production self-hosting setups. Community reports confirm fully local inference via Ollama and local Whisper STT. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party production self-hosting guidance beyond the dev runner and the portability claim.
